original_ai_output.title_zh: 瓦拉普州：阿科特·卢阿尔在SPLM初选争议中以压倒性优势获胜
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹执政党SPLM在瓦拉普州第5选区举行初选，阿科特·卢阿尔·阿雷奇以279票中的275票获胜。三名竞争对手因投票程序争议抵制选举，并指控阿雷奇未按规定辞去军职、以摩托车和现金贿赂地方酋长，以及投票站有军人可能恐吓代表。选举委员会称投票合法透明，相关指控尚未获证实。

location.site: 戈格里亚尔西县第5选区（阿孔南、阿孔北和阿莱克西）
location.raw_text: Constituency No. 5, which covers Akon South, Akon North and Alek West in Gogrial West County, Warrap State

key_facts.fact: 阿科特·卢阿尔·阿雷奇在瓦拉普州SPLM初选中以275票获胜
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Arech received 275 of the 279 votes cast on Saturday in Constituency No. 5

key_facts.fact: 三名竞争对手因投票程序争议抵制选举
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the three challengers withdrew after the election committee rejected their demand for a secret ballot and insisted that delegates vote by queue

key_facts.fact: 竞争对手指控阿雷奇未按规定辞去军职并以摩托车和现金贿赂地方酋长
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: They also accused him of bribing local chiefs with motorcycles and cash to influence the selection of delegates

key_facts.fact: 竞争对手反对投票站有军人存在，称可能恐吓代表
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The candidates further objected to the presence of military personnel at the voting centre, saying it could intimidate delegates

key_facts.fact: SPLM初选是2026年12月全国代表大会和大选前的内部候选人遴选程序
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The SPLM primaries are part of the ruling party’s internal candidate-selection process ahead of its national convention and general elections scheduled for December 2026

uncertainties: 阿雷奇是否在参选前正式辞去SSPDF军职尚未证实
贿赂地方酋长的指控尚未证实
投票站军人存在是否构成恐吓尚未证实
选举委员会称投票合法透明，与竞争对手指控存在说法不一
目前仅单一来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
